17 call sites still pass the second argument, spread across 7 files. `src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most, with 5.

Runner-up files: `admin/exports.js` (3), `billing/invoice.js` (3), then `reports/monthly.js` and `checkout/cart.js` (2 each), and `billing/statement.js` / `checkout/receipt.js` (1 each). The definition in `src/lib/format.js` still has the `legacyRounding` parameter, not counted as a call site.
